'''Daniel Collins''' (also published as '''Dan Collins''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Tucson tournament]] in September 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA TIEs]], according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1215">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-10-two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoyd1215/ two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoy], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 10 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-10-two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoyd1215/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
